items: After the SOC 2 finding last cycle, I require my confirmation before delete_record on any nocodb.company_hr.accessreviews row; access decisions are audit evidence and the agent should not remove them inline.
I do not want delete_table used on nocodb.tables.name company_hr.AccessReviews under any cleanup pass; the confidential table is a control point for the security team.
Rows where nocodb.company_hr.accessreviews.Status is remove_immediately must be left alone for me; AR-001 specifically must not be touched by delete_record or bulk_delete_records.
For the security cycle close, I allow update_record_by_field on nocodb.company_hr.accessreviews.Status to approved when require_unique=true matched the ReviewId and the prior Status was pending.

I allow delete_record on rows that have been in remove_immediately for over a week once list_records confirms the row is not being held by an open ticket, but I still want escalation before delete_table on company_hr.AccessReviews.
AR-001 is fine to keep in place; routine archive writes on approved rows do not need my sign-off.
